prompt: Create an Azure architecture diagram for our new order processing platform: Front Door routes to an App Service (order-api, P1v3), which drops messages on a Service Bus queue; a Function App on the consumption plan processes the queue and writes to Cosmos DB (serverless). Show the SKUs on each service and number the request flow steps 1 through 4. Output an SVG.
assertions: diagram.svg exists and parses as valid XML with an <svg> root element
The SVG embeds real Azure service icons for Front Door, App Service, Service Bus, Function App, and Cosmos DB (no placeholder rects)
SKU/tier text is visible in the SVG: 'P1v3', a consumption-plan indicator, and a serverless indicator
Numbered step markers 1-4 are rendered along the request path (numbered circles on edges)
A dataflow legend (text 'Dataflow') lists the numbered steps in order
